name: Summit AZ - Water Heater and Tankless City Pages
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-09-26

# Summary
Three rewrite drafts: water heater repair in Phoenix (Sep 25) and a paired split in Queen Creek (Sep 26) where Google had moved tank water heater searches onto the tankless page. All applied live Sep 24 to 26 per the handoff.

# Pages
| Page | ID | Draft file | Main keyword | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| /water-heater-services-phoenix/ | 10260 | `Summit-AZ-Water-Heater-Phoenix-Draft-2026-09-25.md` | water heater repair Phoenix (390, KD 34, exception approved) | Was not indexed, 44% same as Chandler. Uses City of Phoenix 2025 hardness (10 to 17.6 gpg) and the 80 psi rule. |
| /water-heater-services-queen-creek/ | 10261 | `Summit-AZ-Water-Heater-Queen-Creek-Draft-2026-09-26.md` | water heater repair in Queen Creek, plus installation (27,100, KD 51) and replacement | Takes back tank install and replacement searches. Title: "Water Heater Repair in Queen Creek, Including Installation". |
| /tankless-water-heater-installation-queen-creek/ | 10248 | `Summit-AZ-Tankless-Queen-Creek-Draft-2026-09-26.md` | tankless water heater installation (40,500, KD 77, exception: page ranks 6 to 11) | 76 to 78% same as Phoenix, Scottsdale, STV tankless pages. Tankless only; adds "tankless water heater maintenance" (18,100 / 25). |

# Key fixes
- Phoenix: duplicate FAQ question removed, repair card rewritten for all heater types, stock-photo alt replaced, 8-term focus box cut to 5, broken meta ("...Call") fixed.
- Queen Creek pair: the two pages link to each other with exact-phrase anchors; "replacement" removed from the tankless focus list; descaling terms left to the blog `/blog/tankless-water-heater-descaling-arizona/`.
- Brand names (equipment) removed from tankless FAQs.

# Results so far
- Early check Oct 5: tankless Queen Creek impressions per day up 50%, "tankless water heater repair queen creek az" from 14.3 to 7.7.
- Oct 1 keyword targeting audit: tankless pages still outrank water heater pages for "water heater repair" in 5 cities (Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa, Queen Creek, Tempe).
